topic: Pure Fourier Series: Decoding the Language of Waves

sections.title: The Hook: The Musical Analogy
lecture_lines: Complex periodic signals are just chords of sine waves.
A cat’s purr reveals a base and harmonics.
Chaotic waves resolve into ordered stacks of harmonics.

Animate notes coalescing into a single clear melody line.

sections.title: The Core Concept: Defining Fourier Series
lecture_lines: Periodic f(x) decomposes into sums of sines and cosines.
Fourier coefficients represent the weight of each frequency.
Think of it like a harmonic light mixer.
animations: Draw a periodic square wave on the screen. (Color: #FFFFFF) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/mixer.svg]
Show a single sine wave overlapping the square wave. (Color: #FF00FF)
Add more sine waves, amplitude decreasing, to approximate the square. (Color: #00FF00) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/mixer.svg]

sections.title: Visualizing Coefficients: The Integration Trick
lecture_lines: Orthogonality allows us to sift specific frequency components.
Integration acts as a tuner for frequencies.
This isolates pure signals from the static air.
animations: Display the integral formula for coefficients. (Color: #FFFFFF) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/radio.svg]

sections.title: Step-by-Step Construction: Synthesis
lecture_lines: Summing harmonics builds complex waves piece by piece.
Adding more terms reveals sharp square wave edges.
Gibbs phenomenon appears at the sharp corners.

sections.title: Conclusion & Application
lecture_lines: We map signals from time into frequency domains.
Noise-canceling headphones neutralize drone frequencies instantly.
Fourier analysis transforms our digital, modern world.
